p5_b4.ocr: Effect of climate on assaults and batteries occurring in the street, by time of day. In Table 6 we show the percentage change in the average incidence of aggravated assaults and bat- teries that occur on the street, by time of day, due to fluctuations in climate variables, by season of year. For times between 5 AM to 8:59 PM, the incidence of assaults and batteries on the street is significantly positively associated with temperature for all seasons of the year, except during the autumn between noon to 4:59 PM. For times between 9 PM to 4:59 AM, there is no signifi- cant association, except during the summer between 9 AM to 11:59 PM. Rain, wind, humidity, and the square of the temperature are significantly negatively associ- ated with aggravated assaults and batteries occurring on the street.
